pdfjs-dist 6.5.438 (Apache-2.0), legacy build, from the npm registry.
The standard build calls WeakMap.prototype.getOrInsertComputed without a
fallback (Safari 26.2 or later); the legacy build polyfills it, so it is used
for Safari on macOS. Scripting (QuickJS) is not bundled and is disabled.
